title: The Grey Barrow Moors
changes: A new land lies beyond the north-east edge of Oakvale's lands: the Grey Barrow Moors, the misty barrow country of the Ossuary Host.
Find the Moorgate in the forest north of the Hollow Throne. It wakes for heroes of level 20 and above.
The moors are quiet for now: their outpost, monsters and quests are on the way.
